info.label: Goofin’ Records
info.desc: Confusion Is Sex is Sonic Youth's first full length album, originally released in 1983. It was reissued first by SST in 1987 and then again in 1995 on DGC with extra tracks from the Kill Yr Idols EP. The album features a live cover of the The Stooges' "I Wanna Be Your Dog". The cover image is a sketch by bassist Kim Gordon and guitarist Thurston Moore. This image was used on gig posters early in the band's career. Confusion is Sex is the only Sonic Youth album on which guitarist Lee Ranaldo plays bass, specifically on the song "Protect .
info.producers: Sonic Youth, John Erskine, Wharton Tiers

lists.name: RYM Top — Scenes & Movements — No Wave

podcast.body: Released in 1983, *Confusion Is Sex* contributed to the prevailing trend of harder, denser, and more distorted guitar sounds that characterized a segment of the music scene during that year. Its release at the same time as R.E.M.'s *Murmur* underscores the diversity of guitar-driven music appearing in the early 1980s. "sale el primer disco de Sonny Youth, el Confucius Ony Sex."

podcast.title: Debut Album
podcast.body: Sonic Youth's first album, released in the same year as Swans' debut. At the time, it was largely misunderstood, and some professional critics even questioned the band's ability to play their instruments. Today, it is considered a masterpiece of experimentation, recognized as being too advanced for its audience in 1983. "Hoy en día están consideradas dos obras maestras de la experimentación, pero en su día como siempre."
